type.en-US: Steps type: fill, basic or nav.

current.zh-CN: 当前步骤，从 0 开始计数；子 Step 可用 status 覆盖状态。
current.en-US: Current step, counting from 0; a child Step can override the state with status.

initial.zh-CN: 起始序号，从 0 开始计数。

direction.zh-CN: 步骤条方向，可选 horizontal、vertical；用于 basic 与 fill 类型。
direction.en-US: Direction of the steps, horizontal or vertical; applies to the basic and fill types.

status.zh-CN: 当前步骤的状态，可选 wait、process、finish、error、warning；用于 basic 与 fill 类型。
status.en-US: Status of the current step: wait, process, finish, error or warning; applies to the basic and fill types.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 small、default；用于 basic 与 nav 类型。
size.en-US: Size, small or default; applies to the basic and nav types.

hasLine.zh-CN: 是否显示步骤间的连接线；仅用于 basic 类型。
hasLine.en-US: Whether to show the line between steps; basic type only.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the root element.

onChange.zh-CN: 点击或按 Enter、空格选择步骤时调用，参数为该步骤序号（initial 加索引）；点击当前步骤不调用。传入后所有 Step 变为可点击。
onChange.en-US: Called when a step is selected by click or by Enter or Space, with its number (initial plus index); not called for the current step. Passing it makes every Step clickable.

status.zh-CN: 该步骤自己的状态；缺省时随 Steps 的 current 与 status 自动决定。
status.en-US: Own status of the step; when omitted it follows current and status of Steps.

description.zh-CN: 详情描述；nav 类型不渲染。
description.en-US: Description; not rendered by the nav type.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义图标，提供后替换状态图标，内容为空则不显示图标；nav 类型不渲染。
icon.en-US: Custom icon that replaces the status icon; empty content shows no icon. Not rendered by the nav type.
